subject.title: Tracking: cross-process orphan-sweep TOCTOU in provider Cleanup paths (apple-container / local-container / external)

question: Do the three linked fixes provide sufficient stable ownership proof while safely retaining keys or external routing that a concurrent acquisition may already own?
rationale: These cleanup paths perform destructive state mutation, and accepting the exact ownership fence and retained-state behavior requires explicit maintainer security-boundary judgment.

options.title: Review and land all three
options.body: Validate each focused regression and provider-specific retained-state rule, then merge all three fixes and close this tracker only after the final merge.

options.title: Revise retained-state handling
options.body: Request a narrower acquisition fence or alternate garbage-collection design for any provider where indefinite key or routing retention is unacceptable.

options.title: Reject the safety boundary
options.body: Document why same-scope concurrent processes are outside the supported cleanup contract and close the candidate patches without merging.

recommendation.title: Review and land all three
recommendation.body: Validate each focused regression and provider-specific retained-state rule, then merge all three fixes and close this tracker only after the final merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged provider hardening work established the ownership boundary these fixes extend.
